user.title: XY Scope box
user.description: Where the scope box (xy-bench) runs, and the push token from its `.env` (`XYBENCH_TOKEN`).

data_description.host: The box's IP address or hostname on your network.
data_description.port: The port its web page is on (8080 by default).
data_description.token: The value of XYBENCH_TOKEN in the box's .env.

reauth_confirm.title: New token
reauth_confirm.description: The box refused the token. Enter the current XYBENCH_TOKEN from its .env.

error.cannot_connect: The box did not answer. Check the host and port, and that it is running.
error.invalid_auth: The box refused the token, or has no XYBENCH_TOKEN set.
error.unsupported_version: The box speaks a different push API version. Update the box or this integration.

abort.already_configured: This box is already set up.

init.title: Screen inputs
init.description: Which entity feeds each screen. Pre-filled with guesses; change or clear any of them. A cleared input shows as -- on the display.

data_description.weather: A weather entity with an hourly forecast; its rain chance draws the rain bars.
data_description.plant_a: Drawn as the solid line on the Plants screen.
data_description.plant_b: Drawn as the dotted line on the Plants screen.
data_description.car_a: Anything with latitude and longitude attributes.
data_description.power_switch: The smart outlet the scope is plugged into. Display power switches this; off must cut the scope's power, since a stopped signal parks the beam on one spot.
